titulo: Transmission #4: Flight N1317 Asked to Land in a Ghost Town #Shorts
titulo_pt: Transmissão #4: O voo N1317 pediu para pousar numa cidade fantasma
descricao:
A small plane asked to land at an airport that never existed. The tower answered.

Who do you think answered the radio?

Veil Frequency is a fictional horror series. New transmission every day.
artefato: Prefixo N1317 e 'HOLLOW PINES MUNICIPAL — NO SUCH AIRPORT'.
pista: N1317; a torre responde com a voz do Arquivista.

scenes.text: In nineteen eighty-four, a small plane asked to land in Hollow Pines.
scenes.pt: Em 1984, um avião pequeno pediu para pousar em Hollow Pines.

scenes.text: Hollow Pines tower, November one three one seven, requesting landing.
scenes.pt: Torre de Hollow Pines, November um três um sete, pedindo pouso.

scenes.text: There was no airport in Hollow Pines. There never was.
scenes.pt: Não existia aeroporto em Hollow Pines. Nunca existiu.

scenes.text: The pilot said every light in town was on. And nobody was outside.
scenes.pt: O piloto disse que todas as luzes da cidade estavam acesas. E não tinha ninguém na rua.

scenes.text: Then someone answered from the tower.
I listened to it six times. The voice in the tower is mine.
scenes.pt: Eu ouvi seis vezes. A voz da torre é a minha.
